description: This file defines the JsonDownloadFormat class, which extends the DownloadFormat class to provide JSON-formatted string output for given values. It appears to be part of a plugin system related to download formats in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for JSON formatting.

classes.name: JsonDownloadFormat
classes.description: A class that formats data as JSON for download purposes within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string representation of the input values.
